summary: APX SYSTEMS AS (org. no. 990 208 840) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2006-09-11. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 58.290 (Utgivelse av annen programvare); it has 10 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 34.3 m and net income was NOK 1.9 m. CEO: Jan Erik Evanger; board chair: Ingvild Huseby; auditor: FLYT REVISJON AS.
